description: This is my Bring him before me royal guard deck, Enjoy
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Start (8)': Bring Him Before Me, Death Star II: Throne Room, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Oppressive Enforcement, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion; these count toward the deck.
The posted list totals 61 cards: the 'Red (15)' section names only 13 cards (section headers add up to 63). Kept as published.
Posted 'MoP' dested Mobilization Points (Death Star II starting Effect for docking bays; the deck runs five docking bays); 'IAO' dested Imperial Arrest Order.
Posted 'Opperisive Enforcement' dested the Special Edition Effect Oppressive Enforcement (in 2001 it was an Effect, not a Defensive Shield).

Posted 'Space port docking bay', 'Tatooine Docking bay 94' and 'Cloud City Docking bay' dested the Dark sites Spaceport Docking Bay, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 and Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Corsaunt Docking Bay' dested the Special Edition Coruscant: Docking Bay.
Posted 'Vaders Lightsaber' dested Vader's Lightsaber (Premiere) and 'Darth vaders lightsaber' dested Darth Vader's Lightsaber (Special Edition); 'Control/Set for stun' dested Control & Set For Stun.
